issues.description: The type of the Developer.monthsOfSwiftExperience property (and corresponding initializer parameter) is inconsistent between the problem statement/template (Int?) and the solution (Double?). This discrepancy will confuse students about the intended type and may cause mismatches when implementing the required optional-binding and switch logic.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the monthsOfSwiftExperience type consistent across all artifacts. Preferably change the solution to use Int? (matching the problem statement and template): update the property declaration and initializer parameter to Int?, and adjust any logic (switch, increments in attend(course:)) to work with Int values. Alternatively, update the problem statement and template to expect Double? if fractional months are intended — but keep one single type across all files.
